name: Microsoft Store app installation
description: Official Microsoft Store channel for installing supported Windows applications and games on compatible Windows devices.
license_note: Each Store app has its own licence and publisher terms. Review the app's permissions, publisher identity and subscription conditions.
notes: Use Microsoft Store on supported Windows devices for Store-distributed apps.
Some apps are paid or require subscriptions; check the listing before installing.
For Win32 software, use the software publisher's official installer or trusted Windows package manager.
